questions.text: Define market failure and identify types of market failures.
questions.expectedAnswer: Market failure: market outcome allocates resources inefficiently.
questions.markingGuide: Clear definition with identification of main types.

questions.text: Explain externalities and their economic consequences.
questions.expectedAnswer: Externalities: costs/benefits not reflected in market prices.
questions.markingGuide: Explain positive and negative externalities with examples.

questions.text: Analyse government interventions to correct market failures.
questions.expectedAnswer: Policies: taxes, subsidies, regulation, tradeable permits.
questions.markingGuide: Evaluate effectiveness of different policy approaches.

questions.text: Comprehensive analysis of market failure and policy solutions.
questions.expectedAnswer: Synthesise failure analysis with policy evaluation and trade-offs.
questions.markingGuide: Sophisticated analysis of failures and policy effectiveness.
